title: Smoke Aerosol Measurement Experiment (SAME)
scientific_focus: Spacecraft fire safety; smoke-particle size and detector response
objectives: Characterize microgravity smoke aerosol sizes, morphology, and detector response to help improve spacecraft fire detection.
approach: Generate smoke from heated or smoldering test materials aboard the ISS. Measure particle distributions with aerosol sensors and collect samples or measurements to compare against ground-based detector behavior.
status_message: No data available for this investigation yet. Graphs cannot be generated.
